tagline.en_US: Mariadb is one of the most popular database servers. Made by the original developers of MySQL.

description.en_US: MariaDB is a database server created by the original developers of MySQL. It manages relational databases and processes SQL queries for applications. It also includes utility tools to check, analyze, optimize, and repair database tables.

completion_notes: MariaDB has no web interface: applications and clients connect to port 3306 of this container.
The root password is asked for when connecting from another machine. Inside the container, the mariadb command opens as root without a password.
